tm.「ぐぬぬ…… 負けぬぞ！\n これでも 食らえっ！: Grr... I won't lose! Take that!
tm.「この先には ダーハルーネの町がある。\n 船での貿易が さかんだから 人も店も: Gondolia lies ahead. It's a busy trading port with lots of people and shops. Very lively indeed.
tm.「私の妹も そこで はたらいてるんだが\n 忙しいみたいで しばらく会ってないん: My little sister works there, but she's so busy I haven't seen her in a while. I hope she's well...
tm.「私は サーカスで 国を盛り上げていますが\n あの星を見ていると みんなが\n: I try to cheer the kingdom up with the circus, but when I see that star, I understand why everyone feels so gloomy.
tm.「……すると 思った！？\n 陽気なサーカス団員たちは\n こんなことじゃ くじ: ...Thought we'd give up, did you? Cheerful circus folk like us don't let a little thing like that get us down!
tm.「あら お客さま？ ごめんなさいね。\n 夜だから サーカスは 中断してるの。\: Oh, sorry, love! The circus is closed for the night. Come back in the daytime if you want to see the show.
tm.「いつも あまり 子供と遊んでやれないから\n なんとかして サーカスのチケット: I rarely get to play with my son. I'd love to get my hands on some circus tickets for him somehow...
tm.「……あっ そういえば シルバー杯っていう\n 新しいレースが 始まったみたいな: ...Oh, and guess what? A new race called the Silver Cup has started! I can't wait to see it!
tm.「こんな風に ウマの世話をすることが\n アッシの生きがい なんですわ。: Taking care of horses like this... It gives meaning to my life.
tm.「このウマたちが レースに出て\n たくさんの観客を 楽しませると思うと\n う: When I think of these beauties running in the races and thrilling the crowds... It never fails to bring a tear to my eye!
tm.「ファーリス杯で走れて\n ウマたちも うれしそうですし\n アッシも 涙が出る: The horses are so happy they got to run in the Sand National. I am so happy I could cry!
tm.「ファーリス杯 スゴかったですねえ！\n 王子さまも とてもいさましかった。\n: The Sand National was incredible, wasn't it? His Highness rode so bravely! With him, the future of our kingdom is in safe hands.
tm.「星が砕け散る直前 大きな魔力を感じたわ。\n やっぱり 勇者の星は\n ただの: Just before Erdwin's Lantern shattered, I sensed tremendous magic. I knew it—that was no ordinary falling star!
tm.「でも じゃあ なんなのって聞かれても\n 全然 わからないんだけどね。: Mind you, if you asked me what it actually was, I wouldn't have the faintest idea.
tm.「お客さんたちは コウフンさめやらず\n ファーリス杯の感想を 語りあっているよ: My patrons are still buzzing about the Sand National. His Highness's riding has gone down rather well, it seems.
tm.「最後まで戦い抜いた 王子さまの勇敢な背中は\n 私たちが 忘れかけていた大切な: Watching His Highness fight bravely to the very end... It reminded us of something precious we had almost forgotten.
tm.「王子さまが 私たちの光となって\n サマディーを 導いてくださる……\n そん: I have seen a future in which His Highness becomes our shining light and leads Gallopolis onward...
tm.「砂漠の殺し屋 デスコピオンは\n 幾千もの戦いを 切り抜けた騎士たちでも\n: The Slayer of the Sands is a foe that not even knights who have survived a thousand battles could defeat.
tm.「王子さまが ケガをせず\n 無事に 逃げ帰ってこれれば\n それ以上は 望まな: If Prince Faris manages to flee home without a scratch, I shall ask for nothing more.
tm.「例の砂漠の殺し屋が 現れたそうだね。\n あの化け物が のさばっていると 危険: I hear the Slayer of the Sands is back. That monster is too dangerous to roam free. I hope it's caught soon.
tm.「ファーリス杯の熱気も 冷めやらぬ中だが\n シルバー杯という 新たなランクのレ: Everyone is still talking about the Sand National, but a new class of race has begun: the Silver Cup.
tm.「ブロンズ杯のレースで 優勝した者ならば\n シルバー杯に 出場できるだろう。\: Anyone who has won a Bronze Cup race may enter the Silver Cup. If you are interested, head on through.
tm.「そういえば ファーリス杯も終わって\n さっそく 新たなレースが 開催してるそ: Now that the Sand National is over, a new race has already begun, I hear. If you are interested, pay the racetrack a visit.
tm.「オイ 聞いたか。騎士たちに おそれられている\n 砂漠の殺し屋が 現れたそうな: Did you hear? The Slayer of the Sands, the terror of our knights, has been sighted. This is cause for alarm...
tm.「かと 思ったのだが\n あの名高き ファーリス王子さまが\n 捕獲に 向かわれ: ...Or so I thought. But now I hear that the great Prince Faris himself has set out to capture the beast!
tm.「だとしたら サマディーは 安全だな！\n ワッハッハ！ 異常なし！: In which case, Gallopolis is perfectly safe! Ha ha ha! No trouble to report!
tm.「まあ あなた ごぞんじですこと？\n 例の砂漠の殺し屋が 現れたんですって。: Oh, have you heard? They say that dreadful Slayer of the Sands has appeared again.
tm.「最近は デルカダールでも\n 悪魔の子という 凶悪犯が逃げだしたそうですし\n: And with that wicked Darkspawn escaping from Heliodor too... Troubling news never seems to end these days.
tm.「ボク おウマさん だーいすき！\n おっきくて はやくって\n すごく かっこ: I love horsies! They're big and fast and sooo cool!
tm.「そろそろ ねないと\n いけないんだけど……。\n うーん……ねむくならないな: I'm s'posed to be going to sleep soon... But I'm not sleepy at all...
tm.「わたしね さいきん なやんでいるの。\n オトナになったら ファーリス王子さま: I've got a really big problem. When I grow up, should I marry Prince Faris or Faiz?
tm.「おかねもちの 王子さまか\n かっこいい オグイか……\n んー まよっちゃう: The rich prince... or cool Faiz... Ooh, I just can't decide!
tm.「ドウドウ！ ほら いい子にしてないと\n 今晩は メシ抜きにするぞ！: Whoa there! Behave yourself, or there's no supper for you tonight!
tm.「さあ ファーリス杯だぞ！\n みんな しっかり 走ってくれよな！: It's time for the Sand National! Run your hearts out, everyone!
tm.「おお 王子さま 応援してますよ！\n ぶっちぎりで 優勝してくださいね！: Your Highness! We're all rooting for you! Leave them all in the dust!
tm.「今年も ファーリス杯にあわせて\n 王宮お抱えのサーカス団が\n ショーを 開: As every year, the royal circus troupe is putting on a show to coincide with the Sand National.
tm.「なんでも シルビアという有名な旅芸人が\n 来るらしいぜ。長年 サーカスは見て: And they say the famous Sylvando is coming! I haven't been to the circus in years, but I might just go this time.
tm.「伝統のウマレース ファーリス杯のために\n サーカスは 絶賛 特別公演中よ！: The circus is putting on a special run of shows for the Sand National!
tm.「夜の公演では 流浪の旅芸人 シルビアが\n 摩訶不思議なショーを 披露してくれ: Tonight, the Wandering Wonder Sylvando will astound you with his magical show! Off to the box office!
tm.「おーよしよし いいコだ。\n いっぱい食べて 元気に育ってくれよ！: There's a good boy. Eat up, and grow big and strong!
tm.「こら 落ち着け 落ち着け！\n レース前に こんなに 暴れてちゃ\n 本番で: Steady! Steady now! If you thrash about like this before the race, you won't have any strength left for the real thing!
tm.「騎士にとって ウマは かけがえのない友……\n だから こうして 彼らの世話を: To a knight, his horse is an irreplaceable friend. Caring for them like this is a noble part of a knight's duty.
tm.「サマディーのウマは 強くて速いと評判だが\n それは われら騎士たちの\n 愛: The horses of Gallopolis are famed for their strength and speed—thanks to the loving care of us knights.
tm.「さあ レースも いよいよ目前！\n ファーリス王子さまが さっそうと\n パド: The race is nearly upon us! And here comes Prince Faris, striding gallantly into the paddock!
tm.「果たして ファーリス王子さまに\n 勝利の女神は ほほえむのだろうかっ！？: Will the goddess of victory smile upon Prince Faris!?
tm.「みんな 王子さまのレースに 注目してるんだ！\n 女の人たちは 特に そうだね: Everyone's watching the Prince's race—especially the ladies! It's going to be a hot one, no doubt about it!
tm.「ファーリス杯の王子さまが 影武者だと知って\n さっそく みんなで マネしてる: The Prince in the Sand National was a body double, so now we're all copying it! It's going to be a hot race!
tm.「うおおおおお すげえええ！\n これが レース前の パドックかあ！\n なあな: Whoaaa, amazing! So this is the paddock before a race! Hey, hey, where's Sharukh?
tm.「さすらいの旅芸人 シルビア参上！\n ハイヨーッ パカラッ パカラッ！: The Wandering Wonder Sylvando is here! Hiyaaa! Clippety-clop! Clippety-clop!
tm.「オレも 王子さまの影武者だっ！\n ハイヨーッ パカラッ パカラッ！: I'm the Prince's body double too! Hiyaaa! Clippety-clop! Clippety-clop!
tm.「ファーリス杯も 終わっちゃったし\n これからは ここのサーカス団を\n 応援: The Sand National's over, so from now on I'm gonna cheer for the circus here instead!
tm.「あたしも モグパックンよ！\n ハイヨーッ パカラッ パカラッ！: I'm Sharukh too! Hiyaaa! Clippety-clop! Clippety-clop!
tm.「わああ 本物の王子さまだーっ！\n おウマのレース がんばってねーっ！: Wow, it's the real Prince! Good luck in the horsie race!
tm.「シルビア はや～い！\n ハイヨーッ パカラッ パカラッ！: Sylvando's so fast! Hiyaaa! Clippety-clop! Clippety-clop!
tm.「あたしも 影武者よ！\n ハイヨーッ パカラッ パカラッ！: I'm a body double too! Hiyaaa! Clippety-clop! Clippety-clop!
tm.「きゃーっ ステキー！\n サーカスって 夢みたいねっ。\n あたし まいにち: Eeee, it's wonderful! The circus is like a dream! I want to see it every single day!
tm.「今度こそ 当たるかな……。\n もし 次に はずれたら\n 今月のこづかいは: Maybe I'll win this time... If I lose again, that's my whole allowance for the month gone.
tm.「ステージの お姉さん ステキだなあ。\n もっと 近くの席で見たいけど\n 目: The lady on the stage is so pretty... I want to sit closer, but what if she looks at me?
tm.「ほう……あの ステージの小娘\n なかなか やるじゃないか。\n あたしの若い: Hmph... That young thing on the stage isn't half bad. Not as good as I was in my day, mind.
tm.「うーん……ここからだと\n ステージの お姉さんじゃなくて\n 楽士さんのオシ: Hmm... From here, I get a better view of the musician's backside than of the lady on stage...
tm.「このオジサン もっともらしいこと言ってるけど\n どうも うさんくさくて 信用: This man says all the right things, but there's something fishy about him. I don't trust him one bit.
tm.「だけど ここの所 負けが込んでるし……\n この人の予想を信じて 王子さまでな: Still, I've been on a losing streak lately... Maybe I should follow his tip and bet on Faiz instead of the Prince.
tm.「うーん そこのボウヤたちが 騒がしいねえ。\n こんな夜中に サーカスを見にく: My, those boys over there are noisy. Coming to the circus this late at night—aren't they a little young for it?
tm.「この人ったら 年がら年中 ウマのことばかり。\n すこしは 私のことも 見てほ: All year round, it's horses, horses, horses with him. I wish he'd look at me once in a while.
tm.「……私が かっこよくて 優秀とウワサの\n ファーリス王子のファンになったら\: ...If I became a fan of the dashing, brilliant Prince Faris, do you think my horse-mad husband might get a little jealous?
tm.「ここのネーちゃんの 予想通りにしたら\n この前のレースは 勝てたのさ。\n: I followed the young lady's tip here and won the last race. So I'm trusting her tip this time too!
tm.「王子か オグイかで迷ったんだけどよ。\n すんでのところで オグイに決めちまっ: I couldn't choose between the Prince and Faiz, and at the last second I went with Faiz. Curses! Nothing for it but to drink!
tm.「この国をおびやかす にっくき砂漠の殺し屋も\n いなくなって 酒がうまいぜ！: That cursed Slayer of the Sands is gone, so the drink tastes sweeter! If I win at the races too, it'll taste sweeter still!
tm.「チクショー……。\n 全部 すっちまった……\n かあちゃんに どやされる……: Curses... I've lost the lot... The missus is going to give me an earful...
tm.「また 全部すっちまった……。\n ううっ また\n かあちゃんに どやされちま: I've lost the lot again... Ugh, the missus is going to give me an earful again...
tm.「あんた じっと 見ていられないのかい？\n こういうステージは ゆっくり\n: Can't you keep still? A show like this is meant to be enjoyed sitting down nice and relaxed.
tm.「王子さまが 砂漠の殺し屋を捕らえるそうよ！\n 建国以来 最もすぐれた王子って: The Prince is off to capture the Slayer of the Sands! They don't call him our finest prince ever for nothing!
tm.「シルビアの芸 すごかったなあ。\n あんな芸達者が 抜けてしまったら\n サー: Sylvando's act was really something. With a talent like that gone, the rest of the troupe must be terribly lonely.
tm.「シルビアがいた時は 気づきませんでしたが\n 他の芸人も ずいぶんレベルが高い: I never noticed while Sylvando was here, but the other performers are very good too. I'll keep coming to support them.
tm.「うむ 異常なし！\n あなたさまと ファーリス王子さまのおかげで\n 今日も: All clear! Thanks to you and Prince Faris, Gallopolis is perfectly peaceful today.
tm.「なかなか いい雰囲気だな。\n いつも チケットが売り切れだったが\n 来られ: Nice atmosphere in here. The tickets were always sold out, so I'm glad I finally made it.
tm.「サマディーの王子さまが 伝統のウマのレース\n ファーリス杯に ついに出場なさ: Our Prince is finally riding in the Sand National, our traditional horse race, so the whole kingdom is celebrating.
tm.「中でも 王さまは 今回のファーリス杯に\n ずいぶんと チカラをそそいでおって: The Sultan in particular has put a great deal into this year's Sand National. It's livelier than ever.
tm.「たまには サーカスもいいのう。\n 砂漠の殺し屋が いなくなったおかげで\n: The circus makes a nice change now and then. With the Slayer of the Sands gone, I can enjoy it with all my heart.
tm.「シルビアという旅芸人のショーが\n 評判だと聞いて やってきたが\n もう サ: I came because I heard this Sylvando's show was the talk of the town, but it seems he has already left the troupe.
tm.「なんでも 燃えるナイフを 投げて\n バラに変えてみせたとか……。\n この目: They say he threw flaming knives and turned them into roses... I can hardly believe it without seeing it myself.
tm.「おや ファンの方ですか？\n すみませんが サインなら\n ショーが終わった後: Oh, are you a fan? Sorry, but if you want an autograph, please come back after the show.
tm.「おやおや お客さん！\n ステージに 上がってくるなんて\n 大胆ですなあ！: Well, well! Climbing up on stage? How bold! You can't do that, I'm afraid!
tm.「今度は王子さまが 砂漠の殺し屋を捕まえに\n バクラバ砂丘に 向かうんだってね: Now the Prince is heading to the Celestial Sands to capture the Slayer of the Sands!
tm.「いや～ いい脚してるよな！\n アンタも そう思うだろ？: Cor, wot a lovely set o' legs! You fink so too, don't ya?
tm.「マジかよ。あのウマの脚……\n サイコーに イカしてると 思うんだけどな。\n: You're 'avin' me on! Them legs on that 'orse are the business! I reckon that one's gonna win!
tm.「だよな～ あのウマの脚……\n サイコーに イカしてるよな！\n あのウマが: Too right! Them legs on that 'orse are the business! It's gonna win for sure!
tm.「サーカスを見ていると\n なんだか 元気が湧いてくるわ！: Watching the circus somehow fills me with energy!
tm.「ありがとうよ お客さん！\n おかげで いい料理が 完成できそうだ。\n 少な: Thank you kindly! Thanks to you, I can finish a fine dish. It's not much, but let me give you something for your trouble.
tm.「騎手生命は 絶たれちまったけど\n やっぱり ウマが 大好きでねえ。\n 今で: My riding days may be over, but I still love horses. I still look after them to this day.
tm.「くれぐれも 誤解しないでくれよ。\n こうして 家族３人で暮らしているからとい: Don't get the wrong idea. Just because the three of us live together as a family, it doesn't mean I've forgiven my father.
tm.「アッシも ウマの世話に\n いっそう 気合いが入るってモンです。: Which means I've got to put even more heart into caring for these beauties!
tm.「……これを守るのが 騎士道ってヤツらしいぜ。\n 俺にゃ とても守れる気がしな: ...That's the code of chivalry, apparently. Can't see myself living up to it, mind.
